answer.code: agent-browser eval "(async()=>{const r1=await fetch('/robots.txt');const rt=await r1.text();const r2=await fetch('/sitemap.xml');const st=await r2.text();const sm=[...rt.matchAll(/Sitemap:\s*(\S+)/g)].map(m=>new URL(m[1],location.origin).href).sort();const locs=[...st.matchAll(/<loc>([\s\S]*?)<\/loc>/g)].map(m=>m[1].trim());const host=location.hostname;window.__bench_finding={robotsPresent:r1.ok,robotsSitemaps:sm,sitemapUrlCount:locs.length,allSameHost:locs.every(u=>{try{return new URL(u).hostname===host}catch(e){return false}})};return JSON.stringify(window.__bench_finding)})()"
